aiMetadata.description: Queues a new job to execute a Hystruct document-structuring/data-extraction workflow, identified by its workflow ID. Use this to kick off a workflow run on demand. Not idempotent: each call enqueues a separate job run.

markdown.description:
## Webhook Setup

To receive workflow events, set up a webhook in your Hystruct dashboard:

1. Log in to Hystruct and go to **Integrations**
2. Click **Webhooks** → **Create webhook**
3. Paste this URL as the Webhook URL:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
4. Select the events you want to subscribe to
5. Optionally enter a Workflow ID to filter events
6. Click **Save**

aiMetadata.description: Fires when Hystruct sends a workflow event to the registered webhook, such as a job completing or extracted data being updated; the specific event types are configured in the Hystruct dashboard and can be filtered to a single workflow ID.

fr.## Webhook Setup\n\nTo receive workflow:
## Configuration du Webhook

Pour recevoir des événements de workflow, configurez un webhook dans votre tableau de bord Hystruct :
. Connectez-vous à Hystruct et allez à **Intégrations**
2. Cliquez sur **Webhooks** → **Créer un webhook**
3. Collez cette URL en tant qu'URL Webhook :
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
4. Sélectionnez les événements que vous souhaitez vous abonner à
5. Entrez éventuellement un ID de flux de travail pour filtrer les événements
6. Cliquez sur **Enregistrer**

es.## Webhook Setup\n\nTo receive workflow:
## Configuración de Webhook

Para recibir eventos de flujo de trabajo, configure un webhook en su panel de Hystruct:
. Inicie sesión en Hystruct y vaya a **Integraciones**
2. Haga clic en **Webhooks** → **Crear webhook**
3. Pegar esta URL como la URL del Webhook:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
4. Seleccione los eventos que desea suscribirse a
5. Opcionalmente introduzca un ID de flujo de trabajo para filtrar los eventos
6. Haga clic en **Guardar**

pt.## Webhook Setup\n\nTo receive workflow:
## Configuração do Webhook

Para receber eventos de fluxo de trabalho, configure um webhook no seu painel de Hystruct:
. Inicie sessão em Hystruct e vá para **Integrações**
2. Clique em **Webhooks** → **Create webhook**
3. Cole esta URL como a URL do Webhook:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
4. Selecione os eventos que você deseja assinar
5. Opcionalmente, insira um ID do fluxo de trabalho para filtrar eventos
6. Clique em **Salvar**
